items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview

ctx.x: But you know who was with that band, was Eddie Tompkin, Paul Weston, because we formed a clique, which was the two trumpets and myself and Budd Johnson -- I mean, and Keg Johnson. And a guy named -- I can't think of his name, there was five of us. That's when we all went into Jesse Stone's band, the same way.
